attachments.text:
Claim of 15 July 2026 – values
Policyholder: Eva Lehmann, Kirchgasse 15, 8500 Frauenfeld

Pos. 1 – bought 25 November 2024, Frauenfeld – CHF 1,165
Pos. 2 – bought 18 December 2023, Frauenfeld – CHF 165
Pos. 3 – bought 4 June 2023, online – CHF 120

Total: CHF 1,450

Amounts are the purchase prices paid at the time.

Frauenfeld, 13 September 2026
Eva Lehmann

questions.label: Q1
questions.question: Does the file state that the original purchase vouchers for all of the stolen or damaged items cannot be obtained, or only at considerable cost (not even as a duplicate from the seller)?

questions.label: Q2
questions.question: Does the file state that household contents were stolen or damaged by a theft outside the insured location that was neither a burglary (the thief forcibly entered the building or a room of it, or broke open a container in it, or unlocked it with the correct keys or codes that the thief had obtained by burglary or robbery; a vehicle is not a container) or a robbery (theft under threat or use of violence against the policyholder or a member of the household, or while they could not resist because of unconsciousness, accident or death; pickpocketing and trick theft are not robbery)?

questions.label: Q3
questions.question: Does the file state that the measures could not wait for the insurer's instruction because of imminent danger (Gefahr im Verzug)?

questions.label: Q4
questions.question: Does the file state that measures to reduce the loss are still to be taken (not yet carried out)?

questions.label: Q5
questions.question: Does the policy, or the file, show that the policy does not include the separate supplementary insurance for simple theft away from home (einfacher Diebstahl auswärts)?

questions.label: Q6
questions.question: Is a bicycle among the stolen or damaged items?

questions.label: Q7
questions.question: Does the file state that traces of the theft (for example pry marks, a broken lock, window or container) have been removed or altered, or are to be removed or altered, by the policyholder or on their behalf, for example by repair or cleaning?

text:
Dear Mr Suter,

I kept the lock. The thief cut through the steel cable and left both ends hanging from the rack, and I took it home that evening in a paper bag. It's in my cellar now, exactly as it was, I haven't thrown it away, cleaned it or done anything else with it.

I've attached my list of what was taken with the amounts.

I have the supplementary cover for simple theft away from home on my CSS policy, which I took out in December 2023.

On Wednesday 15 July 2026 I cycled from home to Frauenfeld station, a good ten minutes across town, and locked my bike at the covered racks on the south side at about 11. Then I took the train to Winterthur to meet my friend Nina Ellis for lunch. When I got back at 5, the lock was cut and everything was gone, including the two panniers and the child seat.

There was nothing urgent I had to do before talking to you. I reported it to the police the next morning and waited to hear from CSS.

To be clear, it's an ordinary bicycle: a women's trekking bike, aluminium frame, 21 gears, no motor. I bought it in Frauenfeld in November 2024 for CHF 1,165, and with the bags and seat the total I'm claiming is CHF 1,450.

Kind regards,
Eva Lehmann
Kirchgasse 15, Frauenfeld
